abstract: Exact enumeration of all length-n single-site temporal histories for the 18 semigroup-based three-symbol two-input cellular automata, including a complete three-level trace entropy taxonomy.
integrity: Proof is a self-contained symbolic language count. Direct enumerator checks a finite horizon; novelty and correctness are subject to independent scientific scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: Only the 18 associative semigroup representatives and the origin trace factor on the full bi-infinite shift; neither full cellular automaton entropy nor general ternary CA nor initial-distribution statistics. A bibliographically known closely related submitted 2026 manuscript could contain overlapping results; full text unavailable.
title: Exact temporal trace complexity for all 18 ternary semigroup cellular automata
